name: Set position
why: Keepers set before every shot. A balanced stance lets you push off either way.

setup.space: A clear patch of floor about 1 m square.
setup.parent: Stand in front like a shooter, about 3 m away. Call "Set!" for each rep.

steps: Stand tall and relaxed, facing the parent.
On the call, drop into your stance. Feet about shoulder width, knees bent.
Lift your heels just off the floor. Hands up in front, palms to the parent.
Hold still for 3 seconds, eyes on the parent. Then stand tall again.

mistakes.mistake: Flat feet, heels on the floor
mistakes.fix: Lean forward a little until the heels just lift.
Bring the hands up in front, palms to the parent.

mistakes.mistake: Head bobbing or turning during the hold
mistakes.fix: Keep your eyes on the parent for the whole 3 seconds.

parent_check: Feet shoulder width, knees bent, heels just up
Hands up in front, palms facing you
Head still for the whole 3 s
stop_if: Pain in an ankle, knee or hip
Pain that changes how you move
Chest pain, a racing heartbeat or unusual shortness of breath
Slipping on the floor (fix footwear or surface before going on)

easier.variant: A slower call, and hold the stance for 5 s.
easier.use_when: The heels drop or the head moves.

harder.variant: Walk 2 or 3 steps in, then set on a raised hand.
harder.move_on_when: Every rep clean at 2 x 15, two sessions in a row. Then the owner approves.

dose.tempo: drop on the call, hold still for 3 s
